Maria (PM): quick decision required - post-launch iteration: allocate 20% of sprint capacity to bug fixes and reserves, or split 10% bug + 10% experiment? need one-liner so eng can plan.
Kevin (ENG): 20% bug budget. we've seen p99 blips and a flaky embed cache - need headroom.
Anita (SRE): agree 20% for next 2 sprints. also want a small 'critical-bug buffer' that is not consumed by experiments (security/regressions).
Sam (Design): customer requested a tiny polish (1d). if we go 20% can we still allow one quick UX slot?
Maria (PM): constraints: Dedicated rollout Tue, must keep p99 latency under SLA and cost delta <5%.
Kevin (ENG): with 20% I can promise triage within 24h, fix SLAs 72h for P0/P1. less context switching.
Kevin (ENG): ```labels:
- bug-budget-sprint1
- critical-bug-buffer
- quick-ux-<=4h
```
Anita (SRE): canary gating: if p99 > 200ms or error-rate >0.5% we auto-freeze experiments and prioritize rollback. I'll add alerts+runbook.
Maria (PM): proposal: sprint = 20% bug budget + critical buffer; experiments only if canary metrics green. agree?
Kevin (ENG): +1
Sam (Design): +1 but allow the <=4h UX quick slot if it doesn't touch inference path.
Anita (SRE): :thumbsup: creating runbook now and will hook alerts to #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for release/1.4.2 - 2/10 canary nodes. logs: https://internal/deploys/1711119999
Maria (PM): I'll update sprint board, ping CS re: expectation and SLA. action items: Kevin = top-5 bug candidates; Sam = tag quick UX asks.
Kevin (ENG): adding top-5 to backlog under bug-budget-sprint1, ETA EOD.
Sam (Design): tagged quickwins <=4h and uploaded mocks to tickets.
Maria (PM): thread closed - hedge plan approved: 20% bug budget + critical buffer; experiments gated by canary. thanks all :rocket:
